Specs General Brand Name Nintendo GameStop Exclusive false Gameplay Number of Players 1 Online Multiplayer false Co-op Mode false Perspective 3rd Person Genre Simulation Compatability Compatible Platforms Nintendo Switch Fandom Publisher Name Nintendo Developer Name Nintendo FAQs Frequently Asked Questions What is the release date for Tomodachi Life: Living the Dream? The game is scheduled for a global launch on April 16, 2026. This title marks the first new entry in the series in over 12 years. Which platforms will Tomodachi Life: Living the Dream be on? The game is a native Nintendo Switch title but is fully playable on the Nintendo Switch 2 via backward compatibility. On the Switch 2, the game is optimized for enhanced performance, supporting up to 4K resolution at 60fps when docked and a variable refresh rate of up to 120Hz. What are the new features in the Mii Maker? The updated Mii Maker features a refined cel-shaded aesthetic and introduces human-like ears for the first time. Customization is more modular, allowing you to select front and back hair styles independently and add hair streaks. A new makeup and face paint tool also allows you to draw directly on a Mii’s face using the Switch touchscreen to create non-human characters like aliens or bears. How has the island layout changed from the original Tomodachi Life? The iconic "Mii Apartments" skyscraper has been replaced with a horizontal, expandable island. Players can now use terraforming tools to reshape the land, move shops, and place individual houses anywhere on the map. You can even "paint" ocean tiles into solid ground to expand your island's surface area. What is the new Roommate System? While Miis default to living in their own homes, up to eight Miis can now choose to live together in a single household. Living together acts as a catalyst for "unexpected dramas," such as roommates fighting over the TV remote or engaging in group debates. What is the Palette House Workshop? The Palette House is a creative hub where players can design their own content. Using the touchscreen, you can hand-draw custom pets (like dogs), design latte art, sketch original TV shows for Miis to watch, and even create custom patterns for house exteriors and clothing. What are Little Quirks? Little Quirks are unique habits and behaviors you can gift to your Miis to increase their individuality. These range from specific eating habits and sleep mannerisms (like talking in their sleep) to idle behaviors and unique walking styles, such as floating or high-speed dashing. How do the different personality types affect gameplay? Miis are categorized into one of 16 personality types across four main temperament groups: Easygoing, Outgoing, Independent, and Confident. Their type determines their walking style, standing poses, and how they react to the player, for example, a Confident Mii will answer their door immediately, while an Outgoing Mii will prance enthusiastically before opening it.
